title: Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
Coppergate Devices designs industrial sensors. We need a Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer to set the technical direction of our firmware.

You bring 9+ years of firmware work in C on bare metal and RTOS, you have written drivers for I2C, SPI and CAN, and you have taken a product through EMC tests. You lead design reviews and coach the team.

Not for beginners. Hybrid, two days a week in Munich.
